_about.what: A recorded tokensave code-health audit, with the analyzer's measured false-positive classes beside the raw numbers.
_about.why: A later audit reporting a large move in any of these figures must be answerable as 'the code changed' or 'the resolver changed'. Without a baseline recording the analyzer version AND its blind spots on this tree, that question is not decidable and costs days.
_about.read_this_first: Three of the twelve tools returned numbers that do not describe this codebase. They are recorded with their measured cause so nobody re-derives it. See 'calibration'.

run.index_freshness: last_sync_at 1788819815 against last_updated 1788819610 -- synced after the last write

health.note: quality_signal is the geometric mean of the dimensions x 10000. acyclicity is an artifact (see calibration.import_misresolution), so the headline understates. Over the remaining five dimensions the geometric mean is about 0.86.
health.note_redundancy: 0.9545 derives from dead_count/total_fns, and dead_count is inflated by the false-positive classes below, so the true figure is higher than reported.

bare_name_call_resolution.verdict: hotspots and coupling(fan_in) carry no signal on this tree; coupling(fan_out) is unaffected
bare_name_call_resolution.mechanism: A call to an unqualified common name binds to whichever project symbol shares that name, so stdlib and Qt method calls across the whole repository accrue to one small accessor.
bare_name_call_resolution.why_fan_out_survives: fan_out counts what a file references rather than what references it, so a name collision cannot inflate it.

import_misresolution.verdict: circular and imports cannot plan a decomposition here; the acyclicity sub-score of 0.4093 is not a measurement of this codebase
import_misresolution.mechanism: A bare module import can resolve to a project file sharing a path segment, creating a back-edge that does not exist. Those false edges stitch every file into one strongly connected component.

evidence.reading: a stdlib import bound to a project file

import_misresolution.corroboration: The reported cycle requires src/ to import back from tests/, which it does not. The same single cycle is reported at import-group depth 1, 2 and 3.

python_equivalent_run_instead.reading: clean. The 4 asserts vanish under python -O. The 155 broad handlers are consistent with the project's degrade-and-report policy; this audit did NOT assess handler quality (logs / reports / rethrows / returns a sentinel / swallows silently), which is a separate investigation.

dead_code_false_positives.verdict: of 468 reported, the method half is dominated by Qt wiring and is not a backlog
dead_code_false_positives.method: grep over src/ tests/ tools/ plugins/ benchmarks/ examples/ for each name, excluding its own definition line
